course.title: Algorithms & Data Structures
course.subtitle: A complete path from mental models to tactile interview practice.
course.audience: Learners who want durable algorithm intuition through micro lessons, visualizations, checks, and games.
outcomes: Reason about complexity with concrete growth models
Select data structures by operation contract
Trace searching, sorting, tree, graph, and dynamic programming algorithms
Practice implementation choices through interactive labs

units.title: Mental Models & Complexity
units.summary: Build the vocabulary for comparing algorithms without hiding behind notation.

units.title: Arrays, Strings & Linked Lists
units.summary: Understand contiguous memory, pointer hops, and sequence manipulation.

units.title: Stacks, Queues & Hash Tables
units.summary: Use access discipline and hashing to make operation choices obvious.

units.title: Trees & Heaps
units.summary: See hierarchy, height, ordering, and rotations as spatial operations.

units.title: Graphs
units.summary: Represent relationships, traverse frontiers, and reason about shortest paths.

units.title: Sorting, Searching & Selection
units.summary: Trace ordering invariants from binary search through partition-based selection.

units.title: Dynamic Programming & Greedy Strategy
units.summary: Turn repeated subproblems into tables and distinguish local choices from reusable state.

units.title: Sorting Algorithms in Practice
units.summary: Read, trace, and choose between bubble, quick, and merge sort with real code.

units.title: Searching Algorithms in Practice
units.summary: Trace linear, binary, and jump search on sorted and unsorted data.

units.title: Binary Search Trees
units.summary: Insert, search, and traverse trees with real implementations.

units.title: Graphs & Dynamic Programming
units.summary: Traverse graphs and build dynamic programming tables for classic problems.

units.title: Coding Challenges
units.summary: Apply the algorithms in interview-style challenges with checks and labs.

units.title: Capstone Interview Arcade
units.summary: Bring the course together with problem reading, structure choice, and timed practice.

outcomes: Explain big-o as shape in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

outcomes: Explain loops and growth in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Time Space Tradeoffs
lessons.summary: Trade memory for fewer repeated operations and know when that helps.
outcomes: Explain time space tradeoffs in one minute

lessons.title: Array Indexing

outcomes: Explain array indexing in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Two Pointers
lessons.summary: Move two cursors through a sequence while preserving a boundary invariant.
outcomes: Explain two pointers in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Linked List Pointers
lessons.summary: Feel why pointer rewiring is cheap and random access is expensive.
outcomes: Rewire next pointers safely
Compare arrays and linked lists

lessons.title: Stack and Queue Contracts
lessons.summary: Choose last-in-first-out or first-in-first-out by the story of the problem.
outcomes: Explain stack and queue contracts in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Hash Table Load
lessons.summary: Watch collisions, resizing, and lookup cost as motion instead of mystery.
outcomes: Explain load factor
Predict resize pressure

lessons.title: Sliding Window
lessons.summary: Maintain a moving window so repeated work falls away.
outcomes: Explain sliding window in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Tree Traversal
lessons.summary: Choose preorder, inorder, postorder, or level order by the question being asked.
outcomes: Explain tree traversal in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Heap Invariants
lessons.summary: Keep the best item at the root without fully sorting everything.
outcomes: Explain heap invariants in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Tree Rotations
lessons.summary: Rotate a tree in 3D space and keep inorder order intact.
outcomes: Rotate without losing sorted order
Explain balance as height control

lessons.title: Graph Representations
lessons.summary: Pick adjacency lists or matrices by density and query shape.
outcomes: Explain graph representations in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: BFS and DFS Frontiers
lessons.summary: Watch the frontier expand as a data structure choice.
outcomes: Use queue for BFS
Use stack or recursion for DFS

lessons.title: Shortest Paths
lessons.summary: Separate unweighted BFS from weighted relaxation.
outcomes: Explain shortest paths in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Sorting Invariants
lessons.summary: Name the sorted region and the unknown region before every pass.
outcomes: Explain sorting invariants in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Binary Search Invariants
lessons.summary: Keep the answer inside a sorted window while cutting the work in half.
outcomes: Maintain low and high bounds
Explain logarithmic search

lessons.title: Selection and Partition
lessons.summary: Use partitioning to find a rank without fully sorting.
outcomes: Explain selection and partition in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Recursion to Memo
lessons.summary: Cache answers when branches ask the same question again.
outcomes: Explain recursion to memo in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: DP Grid Fill
lessons.summary: Fill a table by dependency order and feel why direction matters.
outcomes: Identify subproblem state
Fill cells only after dependencies

lessons.title: Greedy Choice
lessons.summary: Prove a local choice is safe before trusting it.
outcomes: Explain greedy choice in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Bubble Sort
lessons.summary: Repeatedly compare adjacent elements and swap out-of-order pairs until the array settles.
outcomes: Explain why the largest value reaches the end each pass
Predict time and space cost

lessons.title: Quick Sort
lessons.summary: Partition around a pivot so smaller values go left and larger values go right, then recurse.
outcomes: Explain what the partition step guarantees
Distinguish average and worst-case cost

lessons.title: Merge Sort
lessons.summary: Divide the array in half, sort each half, then merge the sorted halves back together.
outcomes: Explain why merge sort is always O(n log n)
Describe the cost of the merge step

lessons.title: Choosing a Sort
lessons.summary: Match a sorting algorithm to the input shape, stability needs, and memory budget.
outcomes: Compare bubble, quick, and merge sort on stability and space
Pick a sort for a given constraint

lessons.title: Linear Search
lessons.summary: Walk through the array one element at a time until the target is found.
outcomes: Explain when linear search is the right tool
State its time complexity

lessons.title: Binary Search
lessons.summary: On sorted data, repeatedly halve the search range using the midpoint.
outcomes: Explain why the range always contains the answer
State the time complexity

lessons.title: Jump Search
lessons.summary: On sorted data, jump ahead by fixed blocks, then linear-scan the final block.
outcomes: Explain the block-jump idea
Compare its cost to linear and binary search

lessons.title: Binary Search Tree: Insert & Search
lessons.summary: Keep values ordered by walking left for smaller and right for larger, then insert or search at the empty spot.
outcomes: Explain how insert preserves BST ordering
Trace a search from the root

lessons.title: Tree Traversals
lessons.summary: Visit nodes in different orders to answer different questions about a tree.
outcomes: Name the four traversal orders
Say what inorder produces for a BST

lessons.title: Graph Traversal: BFS & DFS
lessons.summary: Explore a graph with a queue (BFS, by distance) or a stack/recursion (DFS, by depth).
outcomes: Explain the queue versus stack difference
State what BFS guarantees on unweighted graphs

lessons.title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
lessons.summary: Repeatedly relax the cheapest known distance to find shortest weighted paths from a source.
outcomes: Explain the relaxation step
State when Dijkstra is valid

lessons.title: DP: Fibonacci & Memoization
lessons.summary: Turn repeated recursive subproblems into stored answers to avoid exponential work.
outcomes: Explain what memoization stores
Contrast naive recursion with memoized cost

lessons.title: DP: 0/1 Knapsack
lessons.summary: Fill a table of best value per item and capacity to choose what to pack.
outcomes: Explain the dp[i][w] state
Write the recurrence in words

lessons.title: DP: Longest Common Subsequence
lessons.summary: Build a table that grows when characters match and carries forward otherwise.
outcomes: Explain the match versus mismatch rule
State the recurrence

lessons.title: Challenge: Two Sum
lessons.summary: Return the indices of the two numbers that add up to a target.
outcomes: Describe the hash-map one-pass approach
State the time and space tradeoff

lessons.title: Challenge: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
lessons.summary: Merge two already-sorted arrays into one sorted array.
outcomes: Explain the two-pointer merge
State the time and space cost

lessons.title: Challenge: Implement Bubble Sort
lessons.summary: Write bubble sort to sort an array in ascending order.
outcomes: Implement the nested comparison and swap
Add the early-exit optimization

lessons.title: Problem Reading
lessons.summary: Extract inputs, outputs, constraints, and hidden invariants before coding.
outcomes: Explain problem reading in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Choose the Data Structure
lessons.summary: Map desired operations to the structure that makes them natural.
outcomes: Explain choose the data structure in one minute
Choose the right data contract under pressure

lessons.title: Capstone Arcade
lessons.summary: Solve a mixed set of algorithm challenges with hints, checks, and reflections.
outcomes: Pick an approach
Justify complexity
Practice under timed feedback
